name: Roy Ka-Wei Lee
email_source: Printed 'Correspondence to:' line in the arXiv author block of arXiv:2602.21015v1 (arxiv.org/html/2602.21015v1): 'Roy Ka-Wei Lee / Affiliation: Singapore University of Technology and Design (SUTD), Singapore / Correspondence to: roy_lee@sutd.edu.sg'. Printed again in arXiv:2601.13547v1 (HateXScore).
evidence: arXiv HTML confirms: Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Affiliation: Singapore University of Technology and Design. No email printed for him in the paper (only the two correspondence emails, xiaoyuanyi@microsoft.com and jy.bak@skku.edu). LinkedIn: snippet headline 'Roy Ka-Wei Lee - Assistant Professor | Cheng Tsang Man Early Career Chair Professor | Smart Nation Fellow | Adjunct Senior Scientist at CATOS | IEEE Senior Member' at linkedin.com/in/roy-ka-wei-lee - the Cheng Tsang Man Chair Professorship and Smart Nation Fellowship are SUTD-specific, a hard organizational anchor; the same profile also appeared as 'Roy Ka-Wei Lee - Assistant Professor' at sg.linkedin.com/in/roy-ka-wei-lee (same handle, Singapore country subdomain) in a search restricted to SUTD. Snippets further confirm he leads the Social AI Studio at SUTD ISTD (ML/NLP/computational social science on online harms), matching the named person. ResearchGate: profile researchgate.net/profile/Roy-Ka-Wei-Lee-2, snippet reads 'Roy Ka-Wei LEE | Ph.D. Information Systems | Singapore Management University | School of Information Systems', with ~106 publications and ~1,851 citations - matching his documented SMU SIS doctorate and prolific Singapore CS/NLP output; accepted as the same person (profile simply not updated past his PhD). Email: not printed anywhere reachable - SUTD profile pages (sutd.edu.sg, istd.sutd.edu.sg), socialai.studio and roylee.sg are all blocked by the network egress proxy, and no search snippet displayed a full address, so no verified email. Templated addresses deliberately not guessed. ROUND 2: email FOUND via arXiv. roylee.sg, socialai.studio and the SUTD sites are still egress-blocked, so his arXiv output was mined instead: the arXiv API listing for au:"Roy Ka-Wei Lee" was pulled and his recent papers' HTML grepped for addresses. arXiv:2602.21015v1 prints his name, the SUTD affiliation and 'Correspondence to: roy_lee@sutd.edu.sg' in one contiguous, correctly aligned entry, and the same address is printed for him in arXiv:2601.13547v1 (HateXScore), alongside his student yujia_hu@sutd.edu.sg - two independent papers, so no one-author email shift is in play. The sutd.edu.sg domain matches the SUTD/Social AI Studio affiliation already established for him, and other SUTD addresses seen in his papers (bryan_tan@mymail.sutd.edu.sg, weihua_zheng@mymail.sutd.edu.sg, nirmalendu_prakash@mymail.sutd.edu.sg) are students' @mymail addresses, distinct from his faculty one. No address was constructed.
